meta.title: GoNuts: trade the DonutSMP auction house on autopilot
meta.description: A free, open source Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.2 that reads the market, places orders, and lists what it buys, inside limits you set. Off until you turn it on.

hero.title: Trade on autopilot.
hero.sub: The DonutSMP auction house, with a little less watching.

shot.alt: The GoNuts dashboard: realized profit, active listings, opportunities and win rate, with the bot's face at the top

statement: It reads the market. It places the orders. It lists what it buys. And it stays inside the limits you set, off until you turn it on.

tiles.h: DonutSMP switched its API off. GoNuts did not need it.
tiles.p: It reads the market from what the game shows: order house fills, live auction prices, and your own sales.
Nothing to sign up for. Install the mod and join the server.
Press B in game. Every market, every setting, one screen.
It places buy orders in the order house, collects what fills, and lists it on the auction house. It also buys underpriced listings and relists them.
A cap per trade and per session, a dry run mode, and an emergency stop. When something does not match, it stops instead of guessing.
Follow other players and see what they order and list, which markets they work, and who pays whom among them.
A panel in a channel of yours shows what the bot is doing, with buttons to start, stop and tune it.

tiles.h: Tells you when a new build is out.
tiles.p: It shows what each build changes. Turn on auto-update and it installs when you close the game.

install.title: Six steps from download to trading.
install.sub: Watch it through, or pick a step to jump the video to it.

steps.how: Minecraft Java 26.2, Fabric Loader for 26.2, and the Fabric API mod.
One file: `GoNuts-0.1.0-mc26.2.jar` from the Releases page.

steps.what: Put it in your mods folder
steps.how: Close Minecraft first. The folder is `%appdata%\.minecraft\mods`.
Turn the sidebar scoreboard on in `/settings`. GoNuts reads your balance from it.
Check Max per trade and Max per session. Start small.
Click the button, click again within 8 seconds to confirm, press Start.

install.after: After that, leave the game window open and visible with no menu left open. The End key stops it at once.

discord.title: Run it from Discord.
discord.sub: A bot inside the mod posts one message in a channel of yours and keeps it up to date. You start, stop and tune the trader from the buttons under it. New to Discord bots? Watch it through: every click is spelled out.

video.caption: Setting up the Discord panel, with captions

steps.how: A Discord account, a server you own, and GoNuts already trading.

steps.what: Create the bot and copy its token
steps.how: On `discord.com/developers/applications`: New Application, then Bot, then Reset Token.
OAuth2, URL Generator: tick `bot`, then View Channels, Send Messages and Attach Files.
Turn on Developer Mode, right-click the channel, then right-click your own name.
Press B, open Autopilot, click the top right button twice, paste, Save.
Pick a page from the dropdown. Start and Stop work like the buttons in game.

discord.after: The bot token is a password. Never post it or share it. If it gets out, press Reset Token on the developer page and paste the new one into GoNuts.

risk.title: Know the risk before you turn it on.
paragraphs: DonutSMP's rules ban scripts, macros and auto-clickers, and enforcement can reach every account linked to a player. Running live trading is a ban risk that you, the account owner, choose to take.
Watching prices and reading the screens carry no such risk; live trading does. GoNuts is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by DonutSMP.

faq.title: Questions.
items: Do I need an API key?
No. DonutSMP switched off its public API, so GoNuts reads the market from what the game shows: order house fills, live auction prices and your own sales.
No. GoNuts is free and open source under the MIT licence.
Press the End key and it stops at once. You can also stop it from the buttons on the Discord panel.
Where does it read my balance?
From the sidebar scoreboard. Turn it on in /settings after you join DonutSMP.
Is it safe to use on DonutSMP?
Watching prices and reading the screens carry no ban risk. Live trading does: DonutSMP's rules ban scripts, macros and auto-clickers, and you choose to take that risk.
What do I need to run it?
Minecraft Java 26.2, Fabric Loader for 26.2, the Fabric API mod and Java 25.
No. GoNuts is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by DonutSMP.
